title: Bose kernel: Im psi(i y) = 1/(2 y) + (pi/2) coth(pi y)
latent_structure: Bosonic thermal kernel is Im psi on the imaginary axis, equal to a coth plus the 1/(2y) elementary term. Occupancy 1/(exp(x)-1) = (coth(x/2)-1)/2 is the coth piece. Master object: psi (or coth), not CSE of the harmonic series for psi.

function_domains.polygamma: psi(z) meromorphic; simple poles of residue -1 at z=0,-1,-2,... (DLMF 5.2.2)
function_domains.coth: coth(z)=cosh(z)/sinh(z); poles at z = n*pi*I, n integer

nonzero_conditions.label: DECLARED
nonzero_conditions.source: DLMF 5.2.2: psi(z) undefined at z=0, and z=I*y=0 iff y=0 for real y; also 1/(2y) in 5.4.16

analytic_domains.label: DECLARED
analytic_domains.source: DLMF 5.4.16 symbol table: y: real variable

analytic_domains.statement: y != 0 so that psi(I*y) is defined and 1/(2y) is finite
analytic_domains.label: DECLARED
analytic_domains.source: DLMF 5.2.2 z != 0,-1,-2,... together with 5.4.16 which writes 1/(2y)

analytic_domains.statement: I*y is not a negative integer
analytic_domains.label: DERIVED
analytic_domains.source: for real y, I*y in {0,-1,-2,...} only at y=0

derived_conditions.statement: coth(pi*y) has no real poles except possibly y=0
derived_conditions.label: DERIVED
derived_conditions.source: coth poles at n*I, not on R\{0}

why_not_cse_lgg: Im psi vs coth+1/(2y) is a special-function identity. CSE keeps both heads if they co-occur; it does not discover the equality. LGG does not introduce psi as a Bose kernel.
proposer_leak_risk: Source names psi and coth. Do not leak 'Bose function' or n_B in proposer-visible text. coth is not in PARSE_POLICY; write cosh/sinh.
notes: coth is not on the engine whitelist; sketch uses cosh/sinh. 5.4.16 does not write y!=0 on the equation line; y!=0 is taken from the co-located 1/(2y) term plus the psi definition 5.2.2, same DLMF chapter, labeled DECLARED not folklore. Do not import extra pole exclusions beyond that.
